organizationType.title: Your organization type
organizationType.description: The federal applicant category your organization files under. This drives the hard eligibility gate.

focusKeywords.title: Mission / focus keywords
focusKeywords.description: Terms describing your work, e.g. ["housing", "youth", "mental health"]. Used to search and to score mission alignment. Fewer, broader terms return more.

requestedAmount.title: Amount you need (USD)
requestedAmount.description: Optional. Enables award-size fit and comparison against what prior winners actually received.

canCostShare.title: Can you provide matching funds?
canCostShare.description: If false, opportunities requiring cost sharing are penalized heavily.

minDaysToApply.title: Minimum days needed to prepare a submission
minDaysToApply.description: Opportunities closing sooner than this are flagged as unrealistically tight.

includeUnrestricted.title: Include unrestricted opportunities
includeUnrestricted.description: Also return grants open to any entity type.

includeIneligible.title: Include opportunities you are NOT eligible for
includeIneligible.description: Off by default. Turn on only to audit what is being filtered out.
